title: Settings → Email: real domain registration hits the live Resend API
journey: Pre-check: Resend API GET /domains returns 0 (dashboard empty)
Sign in as admin@moveprivatefitness.com; open /dashboard/settings/email (empty state)
Fill the Add a sending domain form: domain e2e-demo.zhiyuantech.ai, from name 'Zhiyuan E2E Demo', default local-part 'noreply'
Click Register domain — the create proc calls resend.domains.create against the LIVE Resend API
Toast 'Domain registered. Add the DNS records and verify.'; row appears with status 'pending'
Expand DNS — shows the REAL Resend-returned records: DKIM (resend._domainkey TXT, p=MIGf…), MX feedback-smtp.us-east-1.amazonses.com (pri 10), SPF (v=spf1 include:amazonses.com ~all)

VERIFIED via Resend API: GET /domains now returns e2e-demo.zhiyuantech.ai, id a5cc92ab-5cc0-4e03-9237-c85b5de2d2c4, status not_started, region us-east-1 — and the DB row stores that same resend_domain_id (real id, not synthetic)
Click Delete → confirm → the delete proc calls resend.domains.remove against the live API
Toast 'Sending domain removed.' and the page returns to 'No sending domains yet'
VERIFIED via Resend API: GET /domains back to 0 + DB row count 0 — dashboard cleaned up. Full create→dashboard→delete round-trip proven against live Resend.

NOTE: the recorded video covers the register + real-DNS-records portion; the delete leg is API-verified (Resend 1→0). Domain does not verify because the DNS records aren't added to the real zhiyuantech.ai zone — that's the only remaining real-DNS step.
